evidence_classes.VERIFIED_REALITY: Directly supported by current primary/public official source for the stated scope.
evidence_classes.VERIFIED_QUALITATIVE_ONLY: Reality effect or structure is supported, but no numeric magnitude/frequency is established.
evidence_classes.MEASURABLE_PRE_NOT_YET_ESTIMATED: Observable before decision from permitted public sources, but no representative estimate has been computed yet.
evidence_classes.MEASURABLE_SCHEDULE_NOT_YET_ESTIMATED: Can be measured from public schedule/program metadata, but target-population frequency is not yet estimated.
evidence_classes.ASSUMPTION_RANGE_ONLY: Synthetic stress parameter; must be represented as a range/world, never as measured reality.
evidence_classes.DEFERRED_RESULT_DEPENDENT: A real empirical estimate would require post-race result/payout evidence currently outside the allowed calibration boundary.

source_policy.yahoo_rule: Yahoo may be used as discovery/sensor/contradiction evidence. User-generated or editorial claims do not become calibration truth without primary or independent corroboration.
source_policy.result_snippet_rule: Search results that expose race outcomes are excluded from calibration evidence unless a later governed protocol explicitly authorizes that result use.
source_policy.bulk_collection_rule: Public visibility does not itself authorize automated bulk collection; no CAPTCHA/WAF/rate-limit/access-control bypass.

verified_structural_facts.fact: 2026 official program metadata includes standard FI/FII 7-rider formats and explicitly identified 9-rider formats in designated events.
verified_structural_facts.model_use: Supports STANDARD_FI_FII_7 default and SPECIAL_9 explicit-only handling; does not by itself establish schedule frequency.

verified_structural_facts.fact: Current official bank records contain 333/335m, 400m, and 500m bank lengths; official glossary defines 333.3/335/400/500m domain.
verified_structural_facts.model_use: Bank-length categorical domain is real; schedule-weighted frequency remains unestimated.

verified_structural_facts.fact: Official racecard guidance defines class, style (逃/両/追), competition score, winning-method counts (逃/捲/差/マ), and B count as pre-race displayed information.
verified_structural_facts.model_use: These displayed aggregates may be treated as PRE-visible fields when captured before decision; underlying raw past results are not opened.

verified_structural_facts.fact: Official guidance recognizes line structures including 2-way, 3-way, 4-way and lone-front-runner patterns; rider introduction is an information point where line formation is presented.
verified_structural_facts.model_use: Line structure is a real PRE concept, but exact decision-time availability must be timestamped separately from earlier publication.

verified_structural_facts.fact: Official race-flow guidance explicitly lists wind direction and wind speed among factors riders consider; magnitude is not quantified by that source.
verified_structural_facts.model_use: Wind effect magnitude must remain a stress range until independently estimated.

verified_structural_facts.fact: Men's keirin class structure includes S-class (S班/S1/S2) and A-class (A1/A2/A3), with periodic class reassignment.
verified_structural_facts.model_use: Class categories are real; current class proportions and race-band frequencies remain unestimated.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Do not present one frequency vector as reality yet. Use broad plausible world weights or equalized stress until schedule-weighted census is defined.
parameters.why: Official 2026 program establishes possible program types, not representative occurrence frequencies.
parameters.next_measurement: Define target population (e.g. men's FI/FII regular races over a fixed date window), enumerate public schedule metadata, then compute program/race-band weights without result data.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Sample class composition only from PRE-visible racecards/rosters; do not infer from results.
parameters.why: Class system is verified, but current S1/S2/A1/A2/A3 composition frequencies are not yet measured.
parameters.next_measurement: Pre-register date window and sample frame, then count PRE class labels.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Use multiple line-shape worlds; never hard-code one 'real' distribution before representative PRE sampling.
parameters.why: Line patterns are verified, but publication timing and provider-specific lineup representation need provenance.
parameters.next_measurement: Capture decision-available line formation from official/event PRE presentation or independently corroborated public PRE source with timestamps.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Keep conditional distributions broad until PRE sample exists.
parameters.why: Style labels are PRE-visible; line position is PRE-observable later, but joint frequency is not yet measured.
parameters.next_measurement: Join PRE style label to PRE line position only within same race snapshot and decision-time boundary.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: B is verified PRE-visible. H/S fields must be reverified against the exact source/interface before calibration.
parameters.why: Do not assume all legacy interface fields remain available or semantically identical.
parameters.next_measurement: Verify exact current PRE schema for B/H/S, then sample only fields exposed before decision.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Use only pre-race displayed aggregate counts; do not open raw result histories.
parameters.why: Official racecard guidance verifies these aggregates as PRE-visible.
parameters.next_measurement: Capture PRE-displayed 逃/捲/差/マ counts with retrieval timestamp and source locator.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Bank-length domain is verified; venue-count proportions must not be mislabeled as race-frequency proportions.
parameters.why: Schedule weighting and venue availability differ.
parameters.next_measurement: Join public schedule to verified bank length and compute schedule-weighted frequency for a pre-registered window.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Use wide synthetic wind worlds until a time-aligned PRE weather sample exists.
parameters.why: Wind is a real factor, but distribution depends venue/season/time. Yahoo Weather may be used as a sensor/cross-check, with source-time provenance.
parameters.next_measurement: Define track-local timestamp alignment, collect normally accessible PRE weather observations from permitted sources, and retain source disagreement.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Stress across signed/near-zero/moderate worlds; never call a chosen coefficient calibrated reality.
parameters.why: Qualitative relevance is verified but causal magnitude is not.
parameters.next_measurement: Future causal/forecast evaluation requires a separately governed dataset/protocol; not needed to run current synthetic stress.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Stress zero-to-strong plausible ranges and compare model failure modes.
parameters.why: Line existence/roles are real; one numeric causal strength is not verified.
parameters.next_measurement: Estimate only under a pre-registered protocol that preserves PRE/result separation and does not touch protected validation.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Use synthetic disruption worlds rather than empirical tuning.
parameters.why: Empirical break rate requires comparing PRE line formation with post-race behavior/outcomes, which is outside the current no-result calibration boundary.
parameters.next_measurement: Defer until a governed protocol explicitly authorizes the necessary post-race evidence without compromising protected validation.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Engineering stress knob only; use a sweep of shock sizes/frequencies.
parameters.why: This is a latent robustness device, not an observable physical parameter.
parameters.next_measurement: No 'true value' claim. Select stress ranges by coverage/robustness logic, not result fitting.

parameters.current_safe_value_policy: Keep synthetic-market bias worlds; do not calibrate to protected outcomes/payouts.
parameters.why: Real market-strength calibration would require outcome-linked market evidence and risks hindsight leakage.
parameters.next_measurement: Only after a governed economic-validation protocol opens the relevant evidence.

yahoo_sensor_notes.use: Suggests hypotheses about wind, line count and bank effects to test against primary/structured evidence; not used to set numeric coefficients.
Useful for discovering current event/track commentary and official/event links; social posts are not proof.

realism_parameters_that_may_be_numeric_t: class/style/decision-method field semantics when captured as PRE
